units: metres, GLB axes (x patient left +, y up, z front +)
about: Phase 7b teaching model of joints and ligaments. Shapes and attachments come from Z-Anatomy (ligaments) and BodyParts3D (bones). Each ligament is a set of straight fibres (tethers) between its two attachments: slack up to the toe strain, then taut (it holds). Joints keep their cartilage surfaces from passing through each other and are pressed gently closed. No forces in newtons: the numbers below are teaching values unless a source is given.
contact_format: [a xyz on bones[0] cartilage, b xyz on bones[1], normal of bones[1] at b, gap mm]
